The '''Savanna Woodland''' is a sub-location of [[The Park]].

{{ZoneText|Chop down Acacia logs.}}

== Features ==
The '''Savanna Woodland''' features various attractions.

=== Melody's Harp ===
{{Main|Melody|Worker Xavier}}
{{NPCSprite|Melody}} is an [[NPC]] located within {{Zone|Melody's Plateau}}, which is connected directly to the '''Savanna Woodlands'''. She is part of "The Rebuild" [[Quests|Quest]], and requires the player to bring her {{Item|Acacia Log|amount=512}}s to repair her Harp. The player will be rewarded for completing the quest with access to the Harp, {{Item|Melody's Shoes}}, {{Coins|2,000}}, {{Skill XP|+1,500 Foraging}}, {{SkyBlock XP|+5}}, and access to the {{Zone|Jungle Island}}.

=== Master Tactician Funk ===
{{Main|Master Tactician Funk}}
Located in a tent near the edge of the '''Savanna Woodland''' is the {{NPCSprite|Master Tactician Funk}}, who sells the {{Item|Tactician's Sword}} and {{Item|Wood Singularity}}.

=== Gold Mine ===
Located near the center of the '''Savanna Woodland''' is a tiny gold mine which can be mined for [[Gold Ore]]. When [[Romero]] asks the player to get him [[Yellow Rock|{{yellow|gold}}]] from this gold mine, the gold has a chance of dropping a [[Yellow Rock]] instead of the ore.

=== Romero ===
{{Main|Romero}}
{{NPCSprite|Romero}} appears in a cave below the '''Savanna Woodland'''. He begins the quest there, and requests a [[Yellow Rock]] before progressing further. After doing so, he will move between locations all across [[SkyBlock]], until he is reunited with [[Juliette]] on the {{zone|Jungle Island}}.

=== Soul Cave ===
{{Main|Soul Cave}}
Near the middle of the gold mine in the '''Savanna Woodland''' lies a breakable wall that can be blown up with an {{Item|Explosive Bow}} or {{Item|Superboom TNT}}. Here, you will find the {{Zone|Soul Cave}}, where {{Item|Pack Spirit}}s, {{Item|Howling Spirit}}s, and {{Item|Soul of the Alpha}}s will spawn. This is one of three caves designed for [[Wolf Slayer]].
